name: Tijuana River Mouth
evidence: Spearman -0.916 between per-beach culture-clean ddPCR flag rate and distance to this point (12 beaches with >=20 paired days, 2022-2026). Distance to the nearest of the 27 curated estuary mouths scores only -0.804 on the same beaches, and Dog Beach O.B. -- 0.3 km from the San Diego River mouth, 26.1 km from here -- flags at 45% against Imperial Beach Municipal's 95% at 2.3 km, so it is this plume and not estuary mouths generally. Continuous transboundary discharge (IBWC); see docs/ASSAY_DISCORDANCE_culture_vs_ddPCR.md section 5.3.
